findings.evidence: Reproduced in Chromium (dev + AX tree via CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree and ariaSnapshot). Lab Value Hacker (bio-02) step: the stimulus is inside
findings.fix_hint: bio-02: render the panel as a real table (the server already sends step values for other missions; a role=list/table of the same 8 rows) next to or instead of the SVG, and make the point choice a listbox/radio group of rows (the answer is a row); hem-01: give the image a long description and offer a text alternative (e.g. a numbered region list). Announce marker moves in a live region. If neither is possible before the committee, state in the demo page and KNOWN_LIMITATIONS that two missions are not usable with a screen reader and that the labs are therefore not accessible end to end.

findings.category: accessibility / repeated wrong answers not announced (B35-001 re-judged)
findings.evidence: Reproduced with a MutationObserver on .case-panel (hem-02 step 1): first wrong answer inserts the role=alert block (1 childList mutation). Second wrong answer (same option) and third (other option): 2 mutations each, both only the Submit button text Checking... -> Submit answer; the alert node is not touched (identical text), focus returns to Submit. Status card goes 1 -> 2 -> 3 and XP penalty keeps growing silently. Judged P2, not P1: the flow remains completable (the first failure is announced, Wrong answers count is readable, a correct answer moves to a new step whose heading takes focus). It is worse than described for a screen-reader user only in that every blind retry is charged -10 XP with no confirmation that anything happened; for order/match the alert text changes when the in-place count changes, so those are announced when progress changes.
findings.fix_hint: Give the alert a changing key (attempt number) or write "Wrong answer N: ..." into a polite live region on every reply, as the order engine already does with its nonce.

findings.evidence: Result screen ledger after a mission with 2 hints and 1 wrong answer shows the row title "No hint used" with sub-text "2 hints used" and value 0, and "First attempt" with "At least one step needed a second try" and 0. The row titles are the names of bonuses that were NOT earned but read as statements, so a row contradicts its own sub-text. Same on Lab results ("No hint used - 0 of 3 missions without a hint", "First attempt - First-try points on 0 of 3 missions").
findings.fix_hint: Title unearned bonus rows as "No-hint bonus (not earned)" / "First-attempt bonus (not earned)" or use kind=unearned styling with a label.

findings.evidence: Error bodies with a non-string message are rendered raw: HTTP 400 {"error":{"message":{"a":1}}} shows "[object Object]" in the alert (Dismiss/Retry panels on every screen), and a 50,000-character message is printed in full in the alert with no truncation. No crash, no blank page, no unhandled rejection in 557 malformed-payload renders (417 field-level mutants accepted by the normalizers and 140 root-level shapes null/[]/string/{}/HTML 200/truncated JSON/204/huge error/odd error body on 14 endpoints), error boundaries never triggered. Only reachable through a broken proxy, hence P3.
findings.fix_hint: In errorFrom() accept root.message / nested.message only when typeof string and cap length (for example 300 chars).

findings.evidence: One result screen mixes: eyebrow "CASE COMPLETE", h1 "Investigation complete.", document title "Mission complete", and student-facing jargon "The backend has recorded your result" (10 occurrences of "backend" across the sweep). Lab map: nav "Lab map" vs h1 "Laboratory map"; nav "Investigations" vs page crumb "Mission control"; XP vs points ("First-try points on 0 of 3 missions" while every other amount is XP). Lab names differ between cards ("Hematology") and vault/lobby ("Hematology Lab"), already known (item 13).
findings.fix_hint: Pick one noun for the unit of play (mission) and one for the unit of score (XP); replace "The backend" by "The server" or nothing.

findings.evidence: iPad-like 820x1180 and 1180x820 (touch): the dashboard hero image is a fixed ~445 px card left-aligned under the CTA with an empty right column (both widths), and at 1180 the "How LabEscape works" steps wrap 3 + 1 (a lone fourth card). No overflow, no overlap; purely unbalanced.
findings.fix_hint: Let .hero-science span the content width below ~1280 px and use 2x2 / 4x1 for the four steps.

findings.evidence: Emulated sleep: with the tab visible, the attempt start was moved 300 s back in the server database (as after a laptop sleep, where performance.now does not advance). After 5 s the countdown still showed 07:55 while the server had 175 s left (GET attempt remainingSec 175); no request was made and nothing signalled the difference. A visibilitychange (hidden then visible) re-synced it to 02:54 at once, and a later submit on an expired attempt gave the correct Time is up panel with focus on Restart. So the display is only wrong while no focus/visibility event arrives (sync happens only on focus, visibilitychange or when the local countdown reaches 0). page.clock fast-forward of 10 min did not make the client declare expiry (server stayed authoritative). Server-side enforcement is correct.
findings.fix_hint: Optional: re-sync every 60 s while a mission is open, or when document.timeline/Date.now() jumps by more than a few seconds.

findings.evidence: Fix the Sample step 1 shows two different identifiers for the same specimen on one screen: the context line starts "Sample 1. EDTA tube, adult female outpatient..." while the chip below reads "Sample S1: EDTA tube with visible clot" (same for steps 2 and 3: "Sample 2." / "Sample S2:"). Content, not code.
findings.fix_hint: Drop the numeric prefix from the context or the S-prefix from the chip.

notes: Own servers: API 3901 (CORS 5901) + dev Vite 5901; API 3902 (CORS 5902) + prod preview 5902 built to a scratch outDir; throw-away seeded DBs; no kill by pattern. (d) Failure isolation: seeded 113 real payloads (all endpoints the student UI calls: me, demo login, labs, dashboard, lab lobby, vault, badges, leaderboard, profile, rules, unlock, mission start, attempt, answer wrong/correct/final, hint, result, lab results), ran 20k field mutations through the real normalizers in the browser (delete/null/wrong type/huge 200k string/1e300/negative/float/empty array/duplicate first element) - 0 raw TypeErrors, every rejected mutant is a PayloadError; then rendered 417 accepted-and-changing mutants in the real UI (restore, answer, hint, completed result, dashboard, labs, lobby, lab results, progress) plus 140 root-level shapes (null, [], string, {}, HTML 200, truncated JSON, 204, 50k error, odd error bodies) on 14 endpoints: 0 white screens, 0 error-boundary hits, 0 pageerror, 0 unhandled rejection; 8 huge-string cases overflow horizontally only in absurd 200k-char fields. Error boundaries exist at three levels (root, per view, around Mission) but were never triggered so their UI was not observed. (a) Prod bundle, cold cache, 4x CPU: LCP 236 ms, 9 requests, 292 KB transferred (CLS 0.013, 2 long tasks max 65 ms); 4x CPU + Slow 3G (400 ms): LCP 3.45 s, 125 KB, 0 long tasks. Played hem-02, hem-01, mic-02, mic-03, hem-03 at 6x CPU + Slow 3G: timer within 1 s of server, double-click on hint = 1 POST, double-click on Submit = 1 POST, CLS <= 0.055, no long tasks; one 290 s stall in a looped run did not reproduce in 3 isolated reruns (machine load). (b) Touch 820x1180 and 1180x820 hasTouch/isMobile iPad UA: point tap lands exactly, long-press places a marker like a click, pinch to scale 5 works with no h-scroll, order move buttons and selects 44 px, touch drag on the order grip does nothing (known B35-003), orientation change keeps marker, order, match choices, hint text, feedback, timer; keyboard-shrink of viewport while typing vault code keeps focus and value (no auto scroll in emulation). (c) Long session: server clock shift, visibilitychange, focus, page.clock jump, offline/online events, stale hint/score after a hint+wrong made elsewhere (resync on focus correct). (e) Storage: nothing in localStorage/IndexedDB/cookies, no Set-Cookie, token only in sessionStorage and Authorization header (not in URL, title, DOM, console, Referer), 0 requests leaving 127.0.0.1 over the whole sweep and the prod load, no external URL in the bundle; getters that throw and null storage work; Storage.setItem throwing still ends in Demo laboratory unavailable (B35-011, not worse than described). (f) Full text sweep of 162 states (all 10 missions with hint 1..n, wrong answer, correct, result, vault wrong/right code, lab map, lobbies, progress, lab results, settings, About): no typos or raw keys; items B36-003/005/008. (g) about 25 screenshots read with the Read tool (the rest inspected by DOM dumps). Verdict AMBER because one open P1 (accessibility re-rating); no P0.
